integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo classical entropy identities and ergodic-decomposition facts cited in RESULT.md; no computational experiment is used as evidence.
scientific_limitations: The converse proof is stated for homeomorphisms; non-invertible maps are not covered.
No claim is made that strict ergodicity itself is preserved by positive powers.
Originality is based on inspected and indexed literature; an unindexed folklore observation remains possible.
title: Entropy flexibility is invariant under positive iterates
